flags.message: During Google web searches checking whether companion/split decisions (Trauernicht, Parrott, Williams, Platt, Cedeno, Parker) had separate cert petitions, scotusgate.com appeared among grounding source URLs (never opened or fetched) and Gemini Search's AI-synthesized overview generically described No. 26-267 as 'the most active and likely candidate for a grant of certiorari' / 'expected to address' the split, with no numerical odds or forecast details. This generic search synthesis was immediately set aside and disregarded, and it did not shape the prediction (P(grant) = 0.24, predicting denial).
